what: West Pharmaceutical Services makes the parts that keep injectable medicines sterile: rubber stoppers, seals, plungers and the systems that deliver drugs by injection. Almost every injectable medicine uses components like these.
customers: Pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies filling injectable medicines, and generic drug manufacturers.
money: high-value stoppers, seals and delivery components
moat: Components written into a medicine's regulatory filing, so changing supplier means refiling with regulators, which almost no drug company will do.
risks: Customer destocking after the pandemic reduced orders for two years
Gross margin of 36% is below its historical level
Capital spending on new capacity was made ahead of demand
opportunities: GLP-1 weight-loss medicines are injectables and use its components in large volumes
Return on invested capital of 13% with very little debt
High-value components grow faster and earn more than standard ones
watch: High-value product revenue growth and capacity utilisation.
